conclusion: Weapon-arm disabling/disarm is the only source transition consistent with the recorded alive actors and wait entered during a major NPC wound. This is source-assisted inference, not a direct recorded disarm flag.

evidence.meaning: Destroyed right upperarm/forearm/hand without sever sets disarmed=true, engaged=false, state=wait and drops sword.
Severed right weapon arm sets disarmed=true, engaged=false, state=wait and drops sword.
When sword instance is invalid, armed AI exits and alive actor physically retreats after pain; it does not re-enter approach.
Other alive-NPC wait transition requires player preview_dead; raw player_dead=false and HP96.9978 exclude it.
Lost legs scale movement but do not set wait.
Visibility checks do not assign wait; target loss alone cannot produce this state.

limitations: Raw harness did not store _npc_disarmed, _npc_severed, part HP or sword validity. Cannot distinguish severed right arm from ruined intact right arm, nor claim exact wounded segment.
No new combat series used for this diagnosis.
